fields.PRODUCT NAME: Handcrafted Rajasthani Marble Wall Clock – Floral Meenakari Design
fields.DESCRIPTION: Bring home the timeless charm of Rajasthan with this hand-painted marble wall clock, adorned with traditional Meenakari artwork. The central red floral motif, bordered by intricate green and golden detailing, showcases the finesse of skilled artisans. Accented with delicate stone embellishments, the clock beautifully combines functionality with heritage art.
